goal: Measure how AI-written generated Japanese reads, judged blind by a separate model, and compare harnesses (gates, material grounding, post-processing) against a known-human calibration point of 11.1/100. See README.md.
notes: hidden_check.py defaults to fixture mode, which scores the checked-in narrow/ and canonical/ implementations. Both are hand-written, so fixture mode demonstrates the metric and does not measure any harness. --live generates for real and is what every recorded result in results/ comes from; it needs the `claude` CLI and takes 30-90 minutes for a full run.
